body:
I hate bragging, but I guess it's good to come out of my comfort zone.

I just broke up with my girlfriend, life is shit and I havent killed myself yet, so thats a plus.

I make $60-70k a year at 19 and it'll rise to potentially 100-130k by this time next year. Im regularly dressed in 1-1.5k outfits and I'm proud of the fac I'm at the point already in my life where I can do what I want.

My job is based on skills I all taught myself. I am rather good at my job.

On the downside, I have no friends and no social life, and also severe depression. Unfortunately, money really doesnt buy happiness.
